name: Default (lab LAN)
description: Same bridge every ProxBox VM already uses. The device gets a lab LAN address and can be reached by ADB from the controller.

name: LAN
description: Lab LAN with the Proxmox firewall off - for devices that need to be reachable from anything on the subnet.

name: Internet only
description: Out to the internet, blocked from the rest of the lab. Enforced by a Proxmox firewall group, not by hope.

name: NAT
description: Behind NAT, no inbound. ADB is reached through the node agent rather than directly.

name: No internet
description: Lab LAN, egress blocked. For testing what an app does with no connectivity.

name: Isolated lab
description: A private VLAN shared by the devices in one lab. They see each other and nothing else. The lab id becomes the VLAN tag.
